title: 'We've got to stop the war': Endurance athlete swims in Strait of Hormuz
summary: As tankers are attacked and blown up nearby, 56-year-old Englishman Lewis Pugh swims in the Strait of Hormuz to draw attention to how the conflict is threatening the area's habitat and wildlife.
